title: thumb_candidates.json
description: Scoring record of the 3 thumbnail candidate stills extracted from the video's own timeline (04b-thumbnails). Persists score + fired criteria per candidate for future CTR correlation; at publish time the owner's pick is written back as chosen:true (without the pick, score↔CTR learning is impossible). Owner picks — no AI ranking beyond candidate selection.

scene.description: Timeline scene_id the still came from (e.g. s03.0).

score.description: Deterministic thumbnailScore (sum of fired WEIGHTS criteria).

reasons.description: Exactly the criteria that fired (keys of score-scenes WEIGHTS).

timestamp_s.description: Absolute video-second of the grabbed frame (settled: after the last enter-beat, before any exit).

file.description: Candidate still, relative to the content dir (images/thumb_candidate_N.png, 1280x720, caption-free).

final.description: Final-ready composited PNG (images/thumb_final_N.png) for YouTube Studio Test & Compare.

source.description: Where the frame was grabbed: the scene's silent HyperFrames clip (caption-free by construction) or the final mp4 at a caption gap (fallback).

chosen.description: Set true on the owner's pick at publish time (build-metadata --choose-thumb).
